critical_code_review_comments: ParticipantDeletionDialog.jsx: search debounce is 300ms and hits GET /admin/participants which returns up to 5000 rows and then filters in Python — for 'Universitas' the JSON payload was 353 items. Consider server-side limit param (e.g. limit=50) to reduce payload/latency for the search dropdown, which currently renders every match inside a max-h-44 scroll list.

In ParticipantDeletionDialog.jsx the default scope when opened without a specific participant is 'campus' (line 9); the design intent is to lead the Super Admin into the new single-search flow. Consider defaulting scope to 'single' when opened in bulk mode so the search panel is the first affordance.

backend/server.py list_participants (5624-5700) still does client-side filtering by iterating the entire registration set and calling .lower() search after DB fetch; consider adding an $or Mongo query on name/email + a $lookup / prefiltering on profiles.institusi for scale.
server.py continues to exceed 7800 lines — participant deletion + preview + search + import handlers should be split into a participants module for maintainability.
